verdict.rationale: Jira's features page names all four requested views, boards, lists, timeline, and calendars, as ways to track the same work's progress. The only support is a single marketing line, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation on switching between views of the same project/issues, independent or hands-on corroboration, and any detail on plan or project-type availability of each view.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work

citations.quote: Stay up-to-date on the work's progress using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars.
